steps.en: OCMS gets the hirer's latest mobile number from the data source
steps.id: OCMS ambil nomor mobile terbaru hirer dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The latest-number lookup is switched off in all environments; the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan nomor terbaru dimatikan di semua environment; nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each individual hirer's outstanding NOPOs are grouped into one SMS
steps.id: NOPO outstanding tiap hirer individu digabung dalam satu SMS
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates produce separate SMSes, and people sharing one number are not de-duplicated.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda jadi SMS terpisah, dan orang dengan nomor sama tidak digabung.

steps.en: No SMS for hirers who opted out, hold a passport, or lack a mobile
steps.id: Tidak ada SMS untuk hirer yang opt-out, ber-passport, atau tanpa mobile

steps.en: The SMS lists the outstanding NOPOs and mentions the 2nd letter
steps.id: SMS memuat NOPO outstanding dan menyebut 2nd letter
steps.why_en: The message wording is kept in the database, so the reference to the 2nd letter cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Teks pesan disimpan di database, jadi rujukan ke 2nd letter tidak bisa dipastikan dari sini.

steps.en: The SMS is sent to the hirer in the batch run
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke hirer dalam proses batch
steps.why_en: SMS sending and the reminder job are both switched off in production settings, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dan job reminder sama-sama dimatikan di pengaturan production, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
